name: crypto
description: Cryptographic hashing, HMAC, and secure random bytes inside DuckDB. Adds BLAKE3, BLAKE2b, SHA-3, the SHA-2 family, MD5, and SHA-1 alongside an order-deterministic aggregate hash for dataset checksums and tamper-evident audit trails.

cta.title: Cryptographic Hashing in SQL
cta.description: Install the Crypto extension to compute hashes, HMACs, and secure random bytes against any DuckDB column — including aggregate hashes for dataset checksums.

quickStart.title: SHA-256 of a string
quickStart.sql:
-- BLOB output, hex it for display
SELECT lower(to_hex(crypto_hash('sha2-256', 'hello world'))) AS sha256;

quickStart.title: 32 cryptographically secure random bytes (e.g. an AES-256 key)
Deterministic checksum of an ordered dataset
quickStart.sql:
SELECT lower(to_hex(crypto_hash_agg('sha2-256', email ORDER BY email))) AS dataset_hash
FROM users;
